summary: Frontend-only static native startup audit completed for Android immediate-crash report. Web preview loads, startup config is mostly aligned (New Architecture + worklets plugin), but one high-risk native dependency mismatch was identified and local Android release validation is blocked by missing Android SDK in this environment.

integration_issues.flow: Android app startup before first React Native screen
integration_issues.issue: High-risk incompatibility suspect: react-native-keyboard-controller is pinned to 1.18.5 while app is on Expo SDK 54 / RN 0.81 / New Architecture. KeyboardProvider wraps root layout, so native init failure here can crash app before UI renders.

react_native_issues.issue: Could not run full Android release compile/install locally: Gradle fails with 'SDK location not found' (ANDROID_HOME/local.properties missing in this container).

action_items: Capture AndroidRuntime stack trace from the crashing signed APK (adb logcat) to confirm exact native module failure point.
Prioritize validating/upgrading react-native-keyboard-controller to an Expo SDK 54 recommended version, regenerate android via prebuild clean, and rebuild release APK.
Fix config drift risk: expo-doctor reports native folders + app.json CNG fields; ensure release pipeline always regenerates native project before Gradle build (already done in workflow).
Optional cleanup: align ICON_VECTOR_VERSION constant in use-icon-fonts.ts with installed @expo/vector-icons version to avoid font asset mismatch side effects.
critical_code_review_comments: PASS: New Architecture is enabled in app.json and gradle.properties, matching reanimated 4 requirements.
PASS: babel.config.js uses react-native-worklets/plugin and keeps it last.
PASS: react-native-worklets resolved to 0.5.1 and react-native-reanimated resolved to 4.1.7 in yarn dependency tree.
RISK: Root layout wraps entire app with KeyboardProvider from react-native-keyboard-controller 1.18.5; if this native module is incompatible, crash happens before first RN UI render.
OBSERVED: expo-doctor check failed for non-CNG sync warning (native folders present + app.json native fields), indicating possible config drift if prebuild is skipped in any build path.
NOTE: AndroidManifest includes legacy READ/WRITE external storage permissions; not a proven crash source, but cleanup recommended for modern Android behavior.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No Android SDK in this container, so startup RCA remains static-audit + web-preview based. Web preview is healthy; issue appears native-only. Focus next run on device/emulator logcat with current signed APK and after keyboard-controller version validation.
rca_of_issue: Most plausible RCA from this run: startup crash is likely native-module initialization failure before JS UI mount, with top suspect being react-native-keyboard-controller 1.18.5 used at root via KeyboardProvider in an Expo SDK 54/RN 0.81/New Architecture app. Repro signal aligns with user video ('keeps stopping' immediately). Mitigation path: collect logcat to confirm, then bump to Expo-recommended compatible version and rebuild via prebuild clean + signed release.
